entry.title: Lipoprotein(a) Identifies Premature Coronary Artery Disease in Patients with Low LDL-Cholesterol: A Large Multicenter Cohort Study
entry.summary: Lipoprotein(a) [Lp(a)] is a genetically determined, causal risk factor for atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease. Whether elevated Lp(a) is associated with premature coronary artery disease (pCAD) in young and middle-aged adults with low LDL-cholesterol (LDL-C) remains poorly characterized in real-world practice.
